name: Northwind Bike Repair

Bring your bike in for a tune-up, a flat repair or a full overhaul. We give you a quote before we start, and we never sell you parts you don't need.

We believe a repaired bike is better than a new one, so we keep old bikes on the road.

posts.title: How often should you oil your bike chain?
posts.description: A simple routine for a quiet, long-lasting chain.
posts.body:
A clean, oiled chain shifts better and lasts longer. Too much oil is as bad as too little: it collects grit.

## Clean it first

Wipe the chain with a rag while you pedal backwards. If it's very dirty, use a chain cleaner.

## One drop per link

Put one drop of chain oil on each link, spin the cranks, then wipe off the excess.

## How often

Every 100 to 200 miles, and straight after a ride in the rain.

posts.title: Storing an e-bike battery in winter
posts.description: Keep your battery healthy through the cold months.
posts.body:
Lithium-ion batteries don't like the cold, and they don't like sitting full for months.

## Charge level

Store the battery at 30 to 60 percent, not empty and not full.

## Temperature

Keep it between 50 and 70°F: indoors, not in a garage or shed.

## Top it up

Check the charge every two or three months and top it up if it has dropped.
